title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin trades at $64,288, up 0.7% in the last 24 hours, while fear grips the market with the index stuck at 26. Network security remains ironclad as hashrate holds 864.9 EH/s. The mempool shows heavy congestion at 96,023 transactions, yet the fastest fee sits at just 3 sat/vB, keeping on-chain costs minimal. Block 957,592 confirms steady production. No major catalysts emerged during the US session, leaving price action driven by thin volume and sentiment rather than fresh flows.
